schedule: absolute QPC target, relative100ns waitable timer due time recomputed each iteration
missed_deadline_policy: record skipped indexes; no catchup burst and no synthetic samples
readback_scope: SM clock only at high frequency; identity once before sampling
timestamp_scope: wait begin/end, timer arm/wake, sample begin/end and independent SM read begin/end
thread_exit_policy: non-daemon; worker alone shuts down NVML; handles close only after confirmed join
measurement_status: Graph collector hardware evidence only; no LLM timing or automatic calibration.
comparison_limit: The previous multi-field Event.wait sampler and this SM-only high-resolution sampler differ in both timer and read scope; improvement is not attributed to the timer alone.
lifetime: Start and verify reader before native launch; request stop only after true native child exit; retain ownership until reader joins.
duration_cap_is_not_success: The 24-hour safety cap is not a measurement-completion signal; every formal window still requires measured bracketing.
final_sample: Read SM once after stop/cap on the NVML-owning thread before NVML shutdown, saved separately from periodic samples.
formal_clock_gate: All30 formal submit-start to final-sync-end QPC intervals need complete read-window brackets with <=25ms uncertainty and2400+/-30MHz.
synthetic_probe_launch_owner: Explicitly reviewed runner and clock_controller, never telemetry import.
